title: documents/1 — one document row of the Connect `documents` dataset (data_pull)
description: v0.1.83 (C373 second-brain lead, 2026-10-27; packages lead review points a-g applied; QA specs#62 S2/S3 applied). Producer: connect (data_pull dataset `documents`): MCP accounts (MCP resources/list + resources/read), database accounts (one table page rendered as CSV per row), later Composio Drive/Notion/Gmail. Consumers: observer (read-only ingest + normalisation; C322(6) ingest = Observer only), knowledge/foundry via Observer deliveries. The account is the data_pull scope instance of the request (the row carries no account); consumers key a document on (account, collection, id). Versions: `rev` is opaque and is compared for EQUALITY only (same rev = same content: skip the row). Order is by `updatedAt` (the newer wins); equal `updatedAt` with a different `rev`: the later-received row wins. A deletion row MUST carry a new `rev` and an `updatedAt` at or after the last live row. Every string member is untrusted input (APP-11(f)), not only `text`: `title`, `path`, `collection`, `author.display`, `url` and `id` too; `untrusted` is always true. Control, bidi and zero-width characters MAY remain and consumers strip them before display or indexing; producers remove NUL. Markdown may carry raw HTML or remote images and CSV may carry formulas (a cell starting with =, +, - or @): consumers never render HTML, never fetch images or links automatically, and escape CSV formulas on export. `url` and `id` carry no credentials, userinfo, tokens or signed query parameters (the producer strips them), and producers drop secret columns from table pages. HTML sources are converted to text/markdown by the producer (no text/html rows). Extra members are allowed and ignored (L24). A source deletion arrives as a row with deleted: true, empty text and title "" (or the last title).

id.description: stable source id (MCP resource uri, `<schema>.<table>:<page>` for a table page); no credentials, userinfo or tokens

collection.description: folder / channel / table the document belongs to; the unit an owner shares and an app picks

path.description: human path, e.g. `Acme LLC/Finance/Q3 board memo`

url.description: https link to the original, when the source has one; no userinfo, no control chars, no fragment; no credentials, tokens or signed query parameters (the producer strips them)

updatedAt.description: UTC; orders versions of one document (newer wins); a deletion row has updatedAt at or after the last live row

rev.description: content version, opaque; compared for equality only (same rev = same content); a deletion row carries a new rev

handle.description: canonical normalizeHandle form (`<channel>:<value>`) when the source maps to one, else the raw source string with raw: true

kind.description: hint for normalisers; `table` = CSV of rows with a header line

text.description: ≤ 262,144 code points; the page stays ≤ 2 MiB UTF-8 (the producer pages by bytes; 50 rows is a ceiling, not a promise)

truncated.description: text was cut to the 262,144 code point cap

page.description: data_pull answer for dataset documents: ≤ 50 rows, ≤ 2 MiB (S-7).
